A staple of the stalker diet. Following the takeover of Rostok. Myklukha became the Zone's principal bread supplier. How an ordinary loaf of bread stays fresh for such an extended period of time is one of the greatest mysteries of the Zone.

Soft and crispy, with the lingering smell of the oven. How on earth Myklukha gets fresh bread to the Zone is anyone’s guess, but it’s only available in Rostok.

The contents of these cans is a mystery that no one dares delve into for the sake of their own sanity. Once healed over a campfire, they transform into a tasty, nutritious meal.

A swollen can of food, expired long before the Zone came into being. Without a decent gas mask, the stench is unbearable.
